# Mykhailo Kloz — Full-Stack Developer

Mykhailo Kloz builds product interfaces and the systems behind them, including APIs, data models, payments, real-time features, and deployment workflows.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://mkloz.com/): Selected work, full-stack scope, technology evidence, and contact details.
- [UEvent case study](https://mkloz.com/projects/uevent): Event discovery, ticketing, payments, maps, and real-time notifications.
- [Webster case study](https://mkloz.com/projects/webster): Canvas-based design tooling and its supporting full-stack system.
- [Chronos case study](https://mkloz.com/projects/chronos): Calendar scheduling and shared coordination.
- [Usof case study](https://mkloz.com/projects/usof): Community publishing, voting, and authentication.
- [Portfolio case study](https://mkloz.com/projects/portfolio): The design and implementation of this portfolio.
- [Citywheels case study](https://mkloz.com/projects/citywheels): E-commerce discovery, checkout, administration, and order management.
